name: @amykit/plugin-command-gate
description: A gate that runs the target repository's own commands.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it with ticket-to-qa, which needs a gate port to decide whether a change is ready for review. It runs the target repository's own commands, listed per repository with a default fallback, and refuses a repository that has neither. With file-worktree mounted, the commands run in the work item's own checkout.
